decision.summary: A sharp transient drop in E and U components occurs around indices 490–495, with N trending upward throughout—indicating asymmetric, non-rigid behavior. E shows early partial recovery starting at 495, but full return is not observed within the allowed context [450,530]. The onset is clear, interior is sustained over ~5 samples, but the return is ambiguous; thus status is uncertain. No other temporary offsets are supported by the original daily samples within the allowed context.

intervals.observation: E drops sharply (~10 MAD) from index ~490 to 495; U also drops concurrently, while N continues upward trend. Partial E recovery begins at 495 but does not complete within allowed context (ends at 530). Return is unobserved/ambiguous; no opposing shift in N or full E/U recovery confirmed.
